title: docs(skills): type-check more objectstack-ui examples with os:check
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9UbbMte2M4pEgfqrXNwg6KKjWH)_

Refs #31112 (slice 3 of a per-skill split: item 4, objectstack-ui; the card stays open)

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:objectstack-ui 技能包里又有 10 段 TypeScript 示例接入了示例编译检查(33 段中由 15 段变为 25 段),涉及动作、页面、仪表盘和看板/甘特视图的示例;没有发现写错的示例。
- 为什么改:AI 编写界面元数据时最先照抄这些示例;接入检查后,规范一旦改名或收紧,示例会在 CI 里立刻变红,而不是悄悄教错。
- 风险与回滚:只改发布技能包的文档文字,不动任何运行时代码;四个文件的 token 上限都未抬高,新增字节靠同文件删减重复说明支付(每处删减的规则都在同文件另有出处)。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`skills/objectstack-ui/rules/dashboards.md`(4 段新接入、删减最多)、`skills/objectstack-ui/rules/list-views.md`(看板与甘特示例改为带类型的 `ListView`)、`skills/objectstack-ui/rules/pages.md`(3 段新接入)。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:skill-examples`,预期最后一行为 332 段示例全部通过类型检查。
- 需要你做的:作为受管面审批人审阅并批准本 PR(skills/** 属 Tier H)。

## What changes

`skills/objectstack-ui` had 15 of its 33 fenced `ts`/`typescript` blocks under `check:skill-examples` (measured on `main` 8210894c, all `*.md` outside `evals/`; `references/_index.md` and the generator-owned `references/react-blocks.md`, which holds no ts block, excluded). It now has 25. Every new mark is the os:check marker on the line above the fence; each wrapper is one import line plus a typed `const` on the existing first line (and, for the two arrays, one opening and one closing line), never more than three lines.

| File | marked before → after / blocks | tokens before → after / ceiling | lines before → after |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| `rules/actions.md` | 4 → 5 / 5 | 2258 → 2257 / 2259 | 181 → 184 |
| `rules/dashboards.md` | 4 → 8 / 9 | 6232 → 6231 / 6232 | 462 → 473 |
| `rules/list-views.md` | 3 → 5 / 11 | 3451 → 3446 / 3451 | 329 → 334 |
| `rules/pages.md` | 1 → 4 / 4 | 5648 → 5668 / 5669 | 426 → 432 |
| untouched: `SKILL.md`, `navigation.md`, `record-page.md` | 0/1, 2/2, 1/1 | headroom 0, 0, 0 | unchanged |

Skills bundle reading: no `SKILL.md` changed, so the sum of every published `SKILL.md` stays 4592 lines.

- **`rules/actions.md`**: the `opensInNewTab` + `newTabUrl` action gains its `defineAction` import and is marked.
- **`rules/pages.md`**: the `kind: 'html'` page gains its `definePage` import; the styled pricing card becomes `const card: PageComponent = { … };` and the doc navigation item `const navigation: NavigationItem[] = [ … ];`. The orphan-looking marker above the master/detail block is over a `tsx` fence and was already counted by the gate, not by this ts tally.
- **`rules/dashboards.md`**: the dataset-bound widget becomes `const widget: DashboardWidget`; the two `filterBindings` widgets and the two `compareTo` widgets become `const widgets: DashboardWidget[] = [ … ];` (the second pair gains the comma between its two objects); the `options` line becomes `const options: DashboardWidget['options']`. The two bare `compareTo:` lines stay a fragment and the file says so once.
- **`rules/list-views.md`**: the kanban and gantt examples become `const board: ListView` and `const timeline: ListView`, so a top-level `groupBy` or a missing `gantt.startDateField` now fails the gate. The bare-key blocks (`data`, `columns`, `filter`, `userFilters`, `sort`, `grouping`) stay fragments and the file says so once.

## Why

#31112 item 4 (ruling B of #22059): published examples are guarded by the opt-in type check, and every defect the P0 text-fix card found sat in an unmarked block. This slice brings objectstack-ui's self-contained examples under it.

### Example fixes

None. Every candidate block was probed in isolation with its wrapper (TS API, syntactic then semantic pass, with a planted unknown key per file as the control leg) and compiled as written.

### Trims that paid the marks (each cut and where its rule survives)

- `rules/actions.md` §Action body context: "— the blessed name (same axes and `undefined` cases as hooks, objectstack-data)" became "(as in hooks, objectstack-data)". The blessed-name rule survives at `skills/objectstack-data/references/data-hooks.md:584` ("the single blessed name") and the same read at `:619`.
- `rules/actions.md` new-tab warning: "builds and draws a checkbox in the dialog" became "draws a checkbox"; the rule (never express new-tab via `params`) is unchanged.
- `rules/pages.md` `kind:'html'`: "; use `kind:'react'` for those" cut; survives in the tier table's `react` row (hooks, `onClick`, expressions).
- `rules/pages.md` styling block: its comment "every block carries responsiveStyles + tokens" cut; survives in the Rules list above it (stable `id` on every styled node, values as design tokens).
- `rules/pages.md` routing: "; that gives one doc many addresses and breaks cross-references" cut; survives as "so a doc has exactly one URL" in the same paragraph.
- `rules/pages.md` live instances: "(one source, never a stale copy)" cut; survives at "Write business concepts" ("has no producer and drifts; the self-describing metadata is the one source").
- `rules/dashboards.md` §compareTo: "The renderer derives the comparison automatically; no second `filter` is required." cut; survives at **Requirements** ("The shifted query reuses the original `filter` shape and replaces only the date-bound clauses"). ", so what a widget declares is exactly what runs" cut; the same-shape statement it followed stays.
- `rules/dashboards.md` KPI example comments: the metric's "renderer fetches the prior quarter and surfaces a secondary value + delta arrow" survives at **Metric widgets** ("a delta arrow plus a trend label"); the chart's "(M2). The renderer issues a second query … overlays it as a muted/dashed series" survives at the §compareTo opening and at **Cartesian charts** (dashed, reduced opacity).
- `rules/dashboards.md`: the metric comment "(binds the crm_task_metrics dataset; filter = runtimeFilter)" survives in the block's own `dataset:` key and at §Dataset-Bound Widgets ("presentation-scope `filter` flows into the query as the runtime filter"); "for this widget only" in the options comment survives in the `dateGranularity` table row ("for this widget only"); the pie/donut rationale clause cut, the rule ("`compareTo` is silently ignored") stays.
- `rules/list-views.md`: "Every view lives under `list` / `form` / `listViews` / `formViews`, as above." survives in §The `defineView` container's first sentence; the `lanes` comment "option VALUES to draw, in this order" survives in the note under the block ("`lanes` chooses the lanes and their order … not one of the field's inline options"); "— past the right edge of a narrow screen —" survives in hand-over item (a) ("scroll right"); "; declare `searchableFields` to choose the set" survives in the table row "declares `searchableFields` | that list, verbatim"; ": nothing ever drew it", "(the block above)" and "(CRUD, live updates, filtering, pagination)" carried no rule.

## Tests

<details><summary>check:skill-examples, before and after, and the reverse check</summary>

- Before (`main` 8210894c): `✅ 322 prose examples type-check across 3 surface(s)`.
- After (head 3bc338ed; 0de24c02 adds only a merge of `main` touching no `skills/**` or `packages/spec` path): `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:skill-examples` exited 0 with `✅ 332 prose examples type-check across 3 surface(s) — every marked block parsed, so tsc ran the SEMANTIC pass on all of them` (skills + docs surface 288 → 298).
- Reverse check, after the commit: planted one wrong key per touched file: `newTabTarget` (`rules/actions.md:165`), `docName` on the doc nav item (`rules/pages.md:365`), the retired widget `position` (`rules/dashboards.md:52`) and a top-level kanban `groupBy` (`rules/list-views.md:264`). The checker exited 1 with TS2353 at exactly those four lines. Restored with `git checkout HEAD -- skills/objectstack-ui`; `git diff HEAD` and `git status --porcelain` were empty after.
</details>

<details><summary>Derived gate sweep (head 3bc338ed)</summary>

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 44 commands. 43 exited 0. `pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads` exited 3 (PREREQUISITE NOT MET: needs every package's dist; CI runs it). `dispatch-gates --ran` exited 0: 44 derived, 43 run, 1 NOT-MEASURED, 0 unrun. Re-run on the merged head 0de24c02: `check-skills-token-ratchet`, `check-changeset-no-major --base origin/main`, `check:skill-links`, `check-empty-changeset --base origin/main`, all exit 0.
</details>

## Acceptance notes

- `check:skill-examples` is not in the derived gate list for a `skills/**` diff, so it was run by hand.
- Unmarked, and why: `SKILL.md`'s `subforms` block is indented three spaces inside a numbered list item, and the gate's fence pattern only reads a fence at column 0, so a marker there would be an orphan; moving it out of the list would break the list and costs bytes `SKILL.md` does not have (headroom 0). In `rules/list-views.md`, `filter`, `sort` and `grouping` would compile with a three-line wrapper (probed green), but each costs about 100 bytes and the file has 5 tokens left after the kanban and gantt marks; `data` (a `[...]` placeholder), `columns` (two statements) and `userFilters` + `appearance` are true fragments. In `rules/dashboards.md` the two bare `compareTo:` lines are a fragment.
- No ceiling was raised or lowered; the ratchet printed no lowering instruction.
- This build ran on the default tier: `dispatch-gates --tier` mandates Fable for `skills/**`, and the claim records the no-Fable-build exit; the contract review is the seat's, on the lane's isolated reviewer.

## Verification

`pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:skill-examples` (needs `@objectstack/spec` and `@objectstack/client-react` built) prints 332 examples green; `node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs` exits 0 with every `skills/objectstack-ui` file within its ceiling.

## Human Minimum

A governed approver reviews and approves (Tier H).
